boundary: The Python reference proves lossless coding and exact micro-ISA transition tables. The accompanying SystemVerilog is synthesizable by construction but area, timing, power, and fold resistance remain pending until Icarus/Yosys/nextpnr CI is observed.
engineering_reading: The full 81-state affine Pauli frame has an exact seven-bit enumerative code. Its 40 nonzero projective classes have an exact six-bit code factored as a four-bit support shell plus a variable relative-sign phase index. This is a one-bit storage reduction from the ordinary four two-bit-trit representation and supplies a support-first lookup decomposition.
